steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Electrify and decarbonize buildings  
   • Retrofit existing homes and offices with high-performance insulation, air sealing, and smart controls.  
   • Require or incentivize all-electric heating, cooling, and water-heating systems, powered by renewables.  

2. Shift to low-carbon mobility  
   • Invest in high-frequency, affordable public transit (light rail, bus rapid transit) and expand safe walking and cycling infrastructure.  
   • Implement congestion pricing or low-emission zones and accelerate electric vehicle charging networks to phase out fossil-fuel vehicles.  

3. Green urban planning and infrastructure  
   • Increase tree cover, green roofs, and permeable surfaces to reduce urban heat islands and sequester CO₂.  
   • Co-locate housing, jobs, shops, and services (transit-oriented development) to shorten trips and lower transport emissions.
